title: Divide and Inject: Can Agents Reconstruct an Indirect Prompt Injection from Fragments?
abstract: arXiv:2609.36576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic systems are now being widely used to orchestrate tools and reason over long contexts. However, the improving capabilities of the large language models powering these agents also create new attack surfaces for indirect prompt injection. In particular, an attacker may not need to place a complete malicious instruction in retrieved content if the agent can reconstruct the objective from incomplete fragments distributed across a long context. In this work, we introduce adaptive long-context prompt injection (AdaLCPI), which combines long-context fragmentation with adaptive search. AdaLCPI splits an attack objective into incomplete fragments, embeds them in external content retrieved through the agent's tools, and uses a reconstruction cue to prompt the agent to combine them. It then iteratively refines the fragments and cue with OpenEvolve using graded scoring and natural-language execution feedback from the target agent. Empirically

translated_title: 分而注入：智能体能否从片段中重构间接提示注入？
translated_abstract: 智能体系统如今被广泛用于编排工具调用并对长上下文进行推理。然而，驱动这些智能体的大语言模型能力的不断提升，也为间接提示注入创造了新的攻击面。特别值得注意的是，如果智能体能够从分布在长上下文中的不完整片段重构出攻击目标，攻击者可能无需在检索到的内容中放置完整的恶意指令。在这项工作中，我们提出了自适应长上下文提示注入，它将长上下文碎片化与自适应搜索相结合。AdaLCPI 将攻击目标拆分为不完整的片段，将其嵌入到通过智能体工具检索到的外部内容中，并利用重构线索诱导智能体将它们组合起来。随后，它借助 OpenEvolve，结合分级评分以及来自目标智能体的自然语言执行反馈，迭代地优化这些片段和重构线索。从实证上……
tldr: 提出 AdaLCPI 间接提示注入攻击方法，将恶意指令拆分为不完整片段散布在长上下文中，利用 OpenEvolve 自适应搜索诱导智能体重构完整攻击目标。
en_tdlr: Proposes AdaLCPI, an indirect prompt injection attack that fragments malicious instructions across long contexts and uses OpenEvolve-driven adaptive search to induce agents into reconstructing the complete attack objective.
